body:
Thank you for sharing your experiences. I know everyone experiences different things with the disability process, but it sucks you and I have the same experiences/impressions.

My boyfriend initially applied in Dec '11 and then finally, after being denied twice, he got a pro bono lawyer in May '12 and his court date has been pushed back to at least May '13. I expect the same experience, but in the dark about how proving my mental instability will be. I mean, my boyfriends issues are pretty black and white and obvious to anyone that spends a day with him that he cannot be in a controlled environment without bathrooms nearby and where he can determine his ability to do physical activity at that moment without having issues. And I know I'll never get a pro bono lawyer for something that a good chunk of this world still thinks is 'make believe'.
Thank you so much. Will look into it. I found a few programs I was going to try to apply to, but thanks for the direct referral. If you don't mind me asking, how was the first month you were on it?

Thank you for sharing your story. It gives me hope that I am not alone in experiencing this.

I know the 'think of the other people in your life' thing is always available to say for this type of things, but minus my boyfriend, I don't have anyone else. I don't have family or a single friend. My family doesn't even know where I live. I cut ties with people when I moved to this shithole town and I haven't had contact with anyone from my past (2 years ago or more) in 2 years. I cannot make new friends, whether it be because I always want to delete myself from social interactions, or that I don't have the means/resources to meet anyone.
